address: Ballynahinch Castle, Recess, Connemara, Ballynahinch, H91 F4A7, Ireland
bio: Located inside the grand 18C Ballynahinch Castle Hotel and surrounded by a particularly picturesque part of the Wild Atlantic Way, there are few more impressive locations to dine than here. Spectacular views of the grounds and river accompany well-versed service and modern, precisely executed dishes. The West Coast larder is used to great effect and features the likes of delicious mussels and clams from Killary Fjord. Be sure to fit in a walk around the grounds or spend time on the peaceful terrace before you leave....
